zh-TW.title: 周邊視野訓練
zh-TW.description: 以三種活動練習處理速度、分散注意力與選擇性注意力：辨認中央閃過的車輛，並找出外圈汽車的方向。

en.title: Peripheral Visual Field Training
en.description: Three activities for practicing processing speed, divided attention and selective attention: name the vehicle flashed in the center and find the car in the outer ring.
